theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_ll_action_mul_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ k, Measurable (hs k)) → (∀ k x, |hs k x| ≤ C) → (∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => hs k x) atTop (𝓝 (h x))) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * hs k x * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * h x * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]))
